title: Project Manager
description:
📢 
**WE ARE HIRING | HVAC PROJECT MANAGER**

**📍 Location:**
 NTPC Power Plant Project, Gadarwara (Near Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh)

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented 
**HVAC Project Manager**
 to join our team for an ongoing NTPC Power Plant Project at Gadarwara.

🔹 Key Responsibilities:

* Plan, manage, and execute HVAC project activities from start to completion.
* Supervise erection, installation, testing, and commissioning of HVAC systems.
* Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, vendors, and client representatives.
* Ensure project execution as per approved drawings, NTPC specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
* Monitor project progress, manpower, material requirements, and timelines.
* Maintain project documentation, progress reports, and commissioning records.

🔹 HVAC Systems & Equipment:

* Air Handling Units (AHU)
* Air Washers
* Centrifugal Fans
* Chiller Units
* Cooling Towers
* Other associated industrial HVAC systems.

🔹 Candidate Requirements:

* Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent qualification.
* Relevant experience in HVAC project execution and management.
* Experience in power plant, industrial, or large-scale HVAC projects will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC erection, installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Excellent leadership, team management, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage site activities and ensure timely project completion.
* **Minimum Experience of 2 years as a Project Manager.**
